scope: October 2026-10-02 guitar only; no September material
method: Same 5s KM184-centered windows; device clip defect exclusion; fixed 335.7/597.7Hz display anchor, >-30dB raw observability; group-median 1/3-octave target 100-3200Hz, smoothness 5, magnitude penalty .4, target +/-4dB; six fixed peaking sections, leave-one-technique-out scoring. Four-device common-mask scores use identical times/bands for cross-device inspection.
cautions: iPhone is an already selected fixed model and exposed to these data; the other three are leave-one-technique-out procedures, so their scores do not form a fair microphone quality ranking.
H1/D10 stereo was downmixed to mono, matching prior October analysis; channel effects may differ.
Same-session design only; no independent new recording.
Magnitude-only comparison does not establish phase, spatial image, or absolute sensitivity.
